name: Shanna
description: Shanna is a magic-immune warrior, a descendant of Captain Sisay, who joined the Weatherlight's crew and later became its captain.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

summary.text: Shanna is a magic-immune warrior, a descendant of Captain Sisay, who joined the Weatherlight's crew and later became its captain.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

bio.text: Jhoira watched Shanna fight Cabal agents on a warehouse roof, recognized her immunity to magic, and revealed she had known Shanna's ancestor Captain Sisay.

bio.text: Shanna agreed to serve on the Weatherlight, and she later helped Liliana and Gideon subdue Thom and noted that the Blackblade was locked in the Stronghold.

bio.text: She fought alongside the crew when Yargle and Urgoros attacked the Weatherlight.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: By 2022 she captained the Weatherlight and promised to come when Karn called it with the amulet.

citations.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

bio.text: When a skeletal dragon attacked and the ship was grounded, she went with Raff and Tiana into a magic-eating barrier, where she confronted and destroyed a nightmare Sisay who mocked her legacy.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

bio.text: After the Weatherlight became a Phyrexian monstrosity, Shanna and Tiana entered it, freed Slimefoot and the powerstone, and escaped as the ship flew away transformed.

status.text: As of the latest story she is alive and captain of the Weatherlight, though she has just escaped the ship, which flew away in its transformed Phyrexian state.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira watches through her owl as a swordswoman fights Cabal agents on a warehouse roof.
timeline.quote: one woman with a sword fought half a dozen men wearing the concealing robes of desert nomads.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira recognizes the woman's immunity to magic.
timeline.quote: It was an immunity to magic, and she had seen it before.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna explains the Cabal agents wanted route maps to attack merchants.
timeline.quote: Cabal agents, trying to get the merchants' route maps

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she knew Shanna's ancestor Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: I knew your ancestor, Captain Sisay. I see you carry her sword.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces herself to Shanna.
timeline.quote: I'm Jhoira. I came here to find you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna agrees to serve on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then I would consider it an honor to have you on my crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen refuses to join, bound to defend Benalia.
timeline.quote: I'm sworn to defend this land.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff Capashen volunteers to go in his sister's place.
timeline.quote: I'm a Capashen. I'm Raff.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff shows his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: In the distance the original version of the Weatherlight angled across the sky.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna argues the killings are not how Cabal agents operate.
timeline.quote: I've hunted Cabal agents in the cities of Jamuraa, and this is not how they operate.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah finds the box holding the ancient artifact empty.
timeline.quote: It's gone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Gideon and Shanna subdue Thom.
timeline.quote: She knocked him flat and Gideon stepped forward to kick the magical device away from his hand.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah asks Jhoira to stay and help hunt Cabal cultists, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: You could stay here and help us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
timeline.quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Tiana warns Shanna that the Phyrexian disguise is damaging the Weatherlight, then a screech signals an attack.
timeline.quote: A screech like nothing Shanna had heard sliced through the air

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, injuring Botono, and a lance tears a hole in the starboard wing.
timeline.quote: one of the lances from tearing a hole in the starboard wing

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.
timeline.quote: "I think that dragon was guarding something," Raff said.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
timeline.quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna confronts a nightmare Sisay who mocks her legacy and shows her visions of her friends dying; Shanna destroys it.
timeline.quote: There was no artistry to Shanna's assault, only brutality.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
timeline.quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
timeline.quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
timeline.quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: On the way back, Velena, Arvad and Elmegraun arrive and the corrupted Weatherlight rains powerbolts, killing Velena and Elmegraun.
timeline.quote: Velena and Elmegraun weren't so lucky and melted into puddles

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight has become a Phyrexian monstrosity, and Shanna and Tiana enter to recover the powerstone.
timeline.quote: a glance was enough to know it wasn't the Weatherlight anymore.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Inside, Shanna destroys tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and frees Slimefoot and the powerstone.
timeline.quote: One thrust, and Botono's death was final

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Tiana and Slimefoot escape the ship, which flies away in its transformed state.
timeline.quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

relations.note: Shanna agrees to join her crew.
relations.quote: Then I would consider it an honor to have you on my crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

relations.note: Raff pilots and obeys the captain.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

relations.note: A reluctant bargain: Braids helps them get in and they help her.
relations.quote: she hadn't tried to kill them yet.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.
